sept 15 N is 2327

```{r}

used <- c("d_crim_abc", "d_incppl_pris_abc","d_incwomen_abc",
          "impact", "incarc", "knowincarc", "vict",
          "local_police", "no_strangle", "police_tracker", "police_training", "charge_police","dpen", "min_wage", "free_calls", "ed_funds", "alt_sentencing", "lwop",
"gov_attn", "vote2020", "willvote", "auto_reg", "post_felony_vote", "early_vote", "election_holiday", "voter_id", "noncit_local", "jail_access_rev", "White", "Black", "Hisp_Latino", "Asian_Am", "Native_Am",  "Pac_Island", "MENA", "race_notlisted",
  "self_ideo", "fire_rare", "fire_privilege", "fire_angry", "fire_fear", "fiscal_ideology", "social_ideology")

used_missing <- data_full %>% 
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(used),
      ~sum(is.na(.))
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "n_missing"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_answered = nrow(raw_data_cleaned)- n_missing,
    pct_missing = n_missing/nrow(data_full) * 100,
    pct_answered = n_answered/nrow(data_full) *100
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_missing))

View(used_missing)

```

```{r}

demos <- c(
  "White",
  "Black",
  "Hisp_Latino",
  "Asian_Am",
  "Native_Am",
  "Pac_Island",
  "MENA",
  "race_notlisted",
   "self_ideo", "fire_rare", "fire_privilege", "fire_angry", "fire_fear", "fiscal_ideology", "social_ideology"
)


data_full <- data_full %>%
  mutate(
    no_controls = if_all(
      all_of(demos),
      is.na
    )
  )

data_full <- data_full %>%
  mutate(
    missing_controls = if_any(
      all_of(demos),
      is.na
    )
  )

data_full <- data_full %>%
  mutate(
    no_controls = if_all(
      all_of(demos),
      is.na
    ),
    missing_controls = if_any(
      all_of(demos),
      is.na
    ),
    
    control_status = case_when(
      no_controls ~ "No controls",
      missing_controls ~ "Some controls missing",
      TRUE ~ "All controls present"
    )
  )

#how many
data_full %>%
  count(control_status)

#version of just ppl w no controls for comparison
df_no_control <- data_full %>%
  filter(missing_controls)

#remove ppl without controls from missing controls
data_full <- data_full %>%
    filter(!missing_controls)

nrow(data_full)

```
